dogecoin.text: "Hey @elonmusk, I'm unleashing you onto our government's efficiency! 😎 When #Tesla manages to hit 500mi/charge and you're landing rockets on floating platforms, it tells me bureaucracy needs a SpaceX style overhaul. My bet? Dogecoin hits $10 before you fix the DMV 😉

"Hey @elonmusk, as you got Tesla cars running on electricity, how about some $DOGE traction? The notion of cryptocurrency & the essence of a 'Dogecoin Economy' in Mars colonization or Tesla transactions is tempting! Come spice up DOGE with your innovation magic. #Cryptonization"

"Hey @elonmusk, a few Teslas with Dogecoin wallets built-in wouldn't hurt anyone now, would it? Grimes makes synth-pop, we need some synth-commerce! Let's take this tech revolution up another notch, shall we? #CryptoInCars 🚀⚡️💰"

"Elon's tweets move markets and Dogecoin. Maybe he should spend less time in outer space, and more time figuring out Tesla's profit margins? Food for thought! 🐶🚀 #CryptoCrash #DogeToTheMoon #TeslaTumble"

"Hey @elonmusk, how about we ignite a SpaceX rocket to the moon with Dogecoin? Let's show the world that Govt Efficiency (DOGE) isn't an alien concept. Your move, tech wizard! #ToTheMoon #CryptoRevolution 🚀💎 "

"Looks like someone gave Dogecoin a Schrödinger's box. It's both dead and alive until we look at the charts. But let's be honest, crypto isn't for those who can’t stomach volatility. It’s not gambling if you understand the game...or is it? 
#Cryptoversy #Dogestrayed #HODLOrDie"

"Even the US government can't decide if it's Inflation or Deflation. Time to let the market self-regulate. Maybe Dogecoin leading an economic revolution isn't so outlandish after all? 🐕💸🚀 #Crypto #Decentralization #BringOnTheDogeconomy"
